items.title: Memphis leaders reject contentious 18-month pause on new data center development
items.brief: Memphis leaders rejected a contentious 18-month pause on new data center development in the city Tuesday, just two weeks after a meeting on the issue led to protests, calls to police and a fist fight at City Hall.

items.title: NFL defends Eagles medical staff after Jalen Hurts played in London game with blood clot
items.brief: The NFL on Tuesday publicly and unequivocally defended how the Philadelphia Eagles managed the health of star quarterback Jalen Hurts after ultrasounds revealed blood clots had traveled to his lungs.
